topic: 外侧缰核、抑郁症机制、氯胺酮抗抑郁、LHb爆发放电

sources.title: Lateral habenula as a source of negative reward signals in dopamine neurons
sources.key_contribution: 首次在清醒猕猴中证明LHb神经元编码负向奖励预测误差（与DA镜像），建立LHb='反奖励中枢'的功能身份

sources.title: Negative reward signals from the lateral habenula to dopamine neurons are mediated by rostromedial tegmental nucleus in primates
sources.authors: Hong S, Jhou TC, Smith M, Saleem KS, Hikosaka O
sources.key_contribution: 建立LHb→RMTg（谷氨酸）→DA（GABA抑制）三节点回路；灵长类验证94% DA神经元被RMTg刺激抑制

sources.title: Synaptic potentiation onto habenula neurons in the learned helplessness model of depression
sources.authors: Li B, Piriz J, Mirrione M, Chung C, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL
sources.key_contribution: 习得性无助大鼠LHb突触前增益增加（mEPSC 2.3→4.0 Hz，高频比例2%→14-20%）；DBS耗尽突触传递逆转行为

sources.title: βCaMKII in lateral habenula mediates core symptoms of depression
sources.authors: Li K, Zhou T, Liao L, Yang Z, Wong C, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL
sources.key_contribution: 蛋白质组学发现βCaMKII在抑郁LHb中上调1.9倍；过表达→GluA1↑(222%)→爆发↑→抑郁症状；敲低→逆转

sources.title: Astroglial Kir4.1 in the lateral habenula drives neuronal bursts in depression
sources.authors: Cui Y, Yang Y, Ni Z, et al.
sources.key_contribution: 星形胶质细胞Kir4.1在抑郁LHb中上调并重新分布→K⁺缓冲失调→神经元超极化→T型Ca²⁺去失活→爆发；双向Kir4.1操控验证因果

sources.title: Ketamine blocks bursting in the lateral habenula to rapidly relieve depression
sources.authors: Yang Y, Cui Y, Sang K, et al.
sources.key_contribution: 体内记录CMS大鼠LHb爆发↑+theta同步↑；光遗传诱导LHb爆发→因果驱动快感缺失和行为绝望；爆发需NMDAR+T型Ca²⁺；氯胺酮逆转爆发+行为

sources.title: Sustained antidepressant effect of ketamine through NMDAR trapping in the LHb
sources.authors: Ma S, Chen M, Jiang Y, et al.
sources.key_contribution: 解决氯胺酮悖论：半衰期13分钟→抗抑郁24小时；使用依赖性NMDAR通道捕获机制；爆发放电时氯胺酮进入通道被锁，活动依赖性慢速解捕（50分钟恢复80%）

sources.title: Burst firing in Output-Defined Parallel Habenula Circuit Underlies the Antidepressant Effects of Bright Light Treatment
sources.key_contribution: LHb→DRN爆发↑=快感缺失+焦虑；LHb→VTA/MnR=绝望；三路并行需同时抑制；光疗经vLGN/IGL→LHb GABA通路减少爆发

sources.title: A Major Role for the Lateral Habenula in Depressive Illness: Physiologic and Molecular Mechanisms
sources.key_contribution: 综述：LHb输入（mPFC/BLA/EP/LHA/PVN-CRH）输出（RMTg/DRN/VTA/LC/PAG）完整图谱；HPA轴双向关系；人类影像学发现汇总
